title: Signal Check
user: Color-blind knowledge workers who need to tell whether a chart, status dashboard, or UI uses color as the only carrier of meaning before they act on it.
smallest_useful_product: Browser extension that samples the visible page/screenshot, detects repeated color-only legend/status distinctions, simulates selected deficiencies locally, and overlays a plain-language warning with label/shape/position alternatives.
success_measure: In a 20-chart benchmark, users identify at least 85% of intentionally color-only distinctions after using the overlay, versus their baseline.
constraints: Simulation is advisory, not a personalized prescription; screenshots may contain sensitive data and must stay local; overlays must be keyboard and screen-reader accessible.
